music_prompt: Confident modern electronic track for a 40 second tech product promo. Starts immediately on the first beat with a punchy kick and warm synth bass, no slow intro. Bright plucked arpeggio, crisp claps, steady 104 BPM, optimistic and clean. Even energy under a voiceover, no vocals, no big drops, short soft ending.
text:
Still looking like this on calls? Your phone has a way better camera. Lens turns it into a webcam for your PC.

Open Lens on the phone, and the PC finds it by itself. Over Wi-Fi, or USB.

In Zoom, Teams, OBS or Discord, just pick the camera called Lens.

Blur the background with one click.

Turn on auto-frame, and the shot follows your face.

Need a minute? Hit pause, and everyone sees, be right back.

Up to 4K at sixty frames per second. No ads, no watermark, no pro version.

Lens. Free, on GitHub.
